name: Dino Experience
description: A journey back in time for all ages, this new immersive exhibition offers a thrilling encounter with the prehistoric world.
longDescription:
The Dino Experience is a new immersive art exhibition opening in Porto, dedicated to the prehistoric era and its most iconic inhabitants. This large-scale presentation aims to transport visitors through time, offering a detailed exploration of dinosaur life, habitats, and the scientific understanding of these ancient creatures. The exhibition leverages contemporary display techniques to bring the subject matter to life for a broad audience.

Visitors can expect an engaging journey through various themed zones, designed to evoke the atmosphere of different geological periods. The experience is suitable for all ages, providing educational content alongside interactive elements. Housed within the Alfandega Congress Center, the exhibition benefits from the venue's expansive spaces, allowing for large-scale installations and a comfortable flow for attendees.

Tickets are required for entry. The Alfandega Congress Center is located near the Douro River, accessible via bus routes 500 and 901, and is a walkable distance from the historic Ribeira district. The exhibition runs from April 30th to May 6th, 2026.
